description: Publishes values from upstream pipeline data to NetworkTables entries with automatic type handling

target_key.description: Entry key under which the value will be published in NetworkTables

schema.description: Published value schema: 'auto' detects from value shape, 'pose3d' and 'pose2d' publish poses, 'detections' publishes repeating class/x/y/z string groups, 'json' publishes objects as a compact JSON string

data_path.description: Optional path of keys or indices used to select a nested value from the pipeline data
